release_notes:
Fix: duplicate invoices from a double-submitted payment page stuck a real deposit as unpaid forever

When a customer accidentally created two identical pending invoices (e.g. a double
click on "Add Funds") and then sent one real payment, the Zelle/Wise reconcilers
refused to credit either invoice, since they couldn't tell which one the deposit
belonged to -- leaving a real payment stuck as unpaid indefinitely.

Add gf_payment_tiebreak_invoice(): when several pending invoices tie on amount (and,
where checked, timing) and all belong to the same user, crediting the oldest one is
provably safe -- each deposit is consumed exactly once, so the wallet that receives
the money is identical no matter which tied invoice absorbs it. A tie spanning more
than one user is still left for manual review, since picking wrong there would credit
the wrong person.
